summary: OLADALENS VENNER (org. no. 987 561 416) is an association (FLI), in the Brønnøysund registers since 2004-12-04. It is active with no bankruptcy or liquidation registered. Its main activity is NACE 91.213 (Drift av naturhistoriske, teknologiske og vitenskapshistoriske museer); it has 0 registered employees. CEO: Odd Kvalfors; board chair: Odd Kvalfors.
